added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own arms: baseline_suite-1795462022968100725.log at 91f8d8d63be reports 58 passed, 0 failed; after_suite-1795462099876888144.log at a9df8ea7 reports 61 passed, 0 failed.

findings.text: plan_sprint_href re-implements the repository's served-document address rule: reckon/evidence.py:1166 _plan_page_href already turns a resolved resource into f"/{project}/{relative}" and resolve_resource already answers None for a document that is not there, so the sprint link's path convention is now defined twice and its .html form can drift.

The open-plan case writes the record frame before appending, so its equality assertion at :339 only covers an existing record not being rewritten; a regression that composes for an open plan when the record is absent would leave it green, and that absence is the state a plan that never landed a record is in.

The dispatch declared the s8 evidence fragment and figure directory as write paths and neither exists in the delivery; the manifest states figures: none and the plan section's own task names only reckon/project_state.py, reckon/evidence.py and the new test, so the omission is a dispatch-spec gap rather than a scope breach.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit a9df8ea7 against 91f8d8d63be: reckon/_store.py (+22), reckon/evidence.py (+197-18), reckon/project_state.py (+26) and the new 353-line test, with the composition reached only through the closure branch of _write_state_locked.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names tests/test_a_closed_plan_has_one_report_naming_its_plan_and_sprint.py with three cases; the manifest records 61 passed in 48.45s at head, and a re-run of that file at head gives 3 passed, EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's one-sentence deliverable is a single report composed at a plan's closure naming the plan and its sprint with each node's figures beneath that node's row; reckon/evidence.py:2022 compose_closed_plan_report and _node_figure_groups at :954 deliver exactly that.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest reports status complete, commit a9df8ea7, three cases passing, a base arm of 58 passed and a negative control of 1 failed at 91f8d8d63be, and names its three log paths on disk.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The six declared paths are reckon/project_state.py, reckon/evidence.py, the new test, the s8 evidence fragment, the s8 figure directory and reckon/_store.py; the diff carries four of them and produces neither the fragment nor the figure directory.

justifications.durability: The sprint assertion at tests/test_a_closed_plan_has_one_report_naming_its_plan_and_sprint.py:288 reddens on a regression that drops the sprint, but the open-plan case pre-writes its frame at :312 so it cannot see composition for a plan with no record.
justifications.evidence: The gate ran the named test inside a fenced suite (61 passed at a9df8ea7, 58 passed at 91f8d8d63be, both EXIT=0), and the negative control reproduces the declared base failure exactly (1 failed, EXIT=1).
justifications.fit: reckon/evidence.py:1461 follows the module's _escape/_source/dataclass idiom and no added name or comment carries a plan, stage or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_store.py:1962 composes the report only on a transition into a landed status, and reckon/evidence.py:1907 gives it the plan and sprint identity the record's first block and head metadata carry.
justifications.reuse: reckon/project_state.py:302 builds a document's served address itself instead of extending reckon/evidence.py:1166 _plan_page_href over a resolved resource, so the record's one address rule now exists in two places.
justifications.scope_discipline: All four delivered files are inside the dispatch's declared write paths and nothing outside them is touched, though the declared s8 evidence fragment and figure directory were not produced.
